description: Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) — an army built with a codex enhancement in the real browser Army Builder reaches the game (WP-C46). Game-side half of the builder end-to-end: server/tests/e2e-custodes-codex.mjs first drives the builder page (Playwright) — faction Adeptus Custodes, detachment Guardians of the Throne (the 10e detachments are hidden), a warlord Shield-Captain whose Enhancement dropdown offers exactly the 4 Guardians of the Throne enhancements, Eagle's Eye picked — and saves it to the cloud as WPC46_E2E_Custodes on a local relay server (the driver points res://server_config.json at it for this run only). No fixture: the scenario runs on the MainMenu. A real click on Refresh Cloud Armies lists the army, it is selected for Player 1, a real click on Start Game downloads it and starts the game; the Shield-Captain carries Eagle's Eye and the list-build pass gave it +1 W (meta and every model), and its datasheet shows the enhancement. Not runnable without that server (the driver: .llm scratch script described in changelog/WP-C46.md).

steps.comment: the driver's temporary server_config.json points at the e2e relay server
Player 1 picks the cloud army in the dropdown; both seats human
steps.script:
var main = tree.current_scene
var idx := -1
for i in range(main.army_options.size()):
	if str(main.army_options[i].id) == "WPC46_E2E_Custodes":
		idx = i
main.player1_dropdown.select(idx)
main.player1_dropdown.item_selected.emit(idx)
main.player1_type_dropdown.select(0)
main.player1_type_dropdown.item_selected.emit(0)
main.player2_type_dropdown.select(0)
main.player2_type_dropdown.item_selected.emit(0)
return main.player1_dropdown.get_item_text(main.player1_dropdown.selected).contains("Cloud")

steps.comment: the Shield-Captain carries Eagle's Eye and +1 W from the list-build pass
+1 W: the game W is the exported (builder) W + 1 — read from the cloud army as downloaded (ArmyListManager.cloud_army_cache), meta and model agree
screenshot framing only: the Battle Formations dialog (an exclusive popup) is hidden so the datasheet is readable; it is shown again after the screenshot
steps.script:
var fd = tree.current_scene.formations_dialog
if fd == null or not is_instance_valid(fd) or not fd.visible:
	return 0
fd.set_meta("_c46_hidden", true)
fd.hide()
return 1

steps.comment: open the Shield-Captain's datasheet (the I-key card)

steps.script:
tree.current_scene.get_node("DatasheetModal").close()
var fd = tree.current_scene.formations_dialog
if fd != null and is_instance_valid(fd) and fd.has_meta("_c46_hidden"):
	fd.remove_meta("_c46_hidden")
	fd.show()
return true
